status: Completed source-to-model accounting and model-to-source review for the frozen structural model, with the qualifications and validation limits below. No entity, stored attribute, relationship, or published route-count change was adopted.

api_groups.mapping: **Represented:** actor is User from context, IDs select existing entity identities (Issue helpers may also accept identifier). **Derived/deferred:** nodes/edges/cursor/pageInfo/totalCount are result views and transport; success/entityId/entity/archivePayload/lastSyncId are operation outputs, not new entities. UserFlag.lastSyncId is separately a real stored field. Mutation argument containers and transactional effects are not domain objects.

**Represented:** same-named GraphQL fields backed by mapped columns retain that entity attribute; named relationship properties follow the exact FK/association recorded in model.json. **Omitted from implemented inference:** public fields with neither storage nor resolver. A field declaration, Python-list/Connection mismatch, or raw ORM object returned where a Payload is expected does not establish operational support. metadata_ and API metadata are not automatically aliases under default resolution. All mapped type fields and relationship shapes are inventoried; storage still remains in the full conceptual model when unexposed.

**Represented:** Issue title/description/descriptionData, dates/SLA/reminder/estimate/priority/order/archive/trash values and team/state/user/cycle/project/milestone/parent/template/source-comment roles. *Id inputs map to their same-named Issue FK where present; createAsUser supplies creatorId; labelIds/addedLabelIds/removedLabelIds and subscriberIds operate on existing labels/subscribers. **Derived:** identifier/number/branchName/url/priorityLabel may be generated. **Separate stores:** labelIds JSON is not the relational issue.labels collection; batch update can diverge. preserveSortOrderOnCreate and permanentlyDelete are behavior controls.

**Represented:** labelId identifies IssueLabel; userId/userEmail identify User; subscription and label pair tables are relationships. IssueLabel color/name/description/retirement/group flags and team/organization/creator/parent/inherited roles stay distinct. IssueRelation issueId/relatedIssueId/type are two endpoints plus classification; overrideCreatedAt is a timestamp input. replaceTeamLabels is a behavior control. The two title snapshots are retained as stored values, not recomputed identity.

**Represented:** Comment body/bodyData/quotedText, archive/edit/resolve fields and actor/context/parent/resolvingComment/resolvingUser/subscriber roles. Context keys issueId/documentContentId/projectUpdateId/initiativeUpdateId/postId select different stored links. creator comes from context. **Derived:** Issue.documents joins DocumentContent.documentId and issueId; it does not add a direct stored Issue–Document edge. Comment.documentId and documentContentId remain different FK roles.

**Represented:** Attachment title/subtitle/url/iconUrl/groupBySource/bodyData, creator/externalUserCreator, issue/originalIssue and metadata_ / source / sourceType. Input metadata maps to metadata_ in writers. External channelId/messageTs/workspace/conversationId/partId/jiraIssueId/caseId/ticketId/repo/owner/number/projectPathWithNamespace/linkKind are structured source metadata or URL composition. They do not create local Slack/GitHub/Jira/etc. entities. commentBody/commentBodyData may create a local Comment. Sync flags alter metadata; they do not demonstrate a live external synchronization service.

**Represented:** Cycle teamId/name/description/startsAt/endsAt/completedAt and stored classification/progress fields. daysToShift changes existing dates, not a new schedule entity. Team.activeCycleId is a separate stored role. **Deferred:** archive/shift/start/delete effects and requirements; dates do not certify every stored isCurrent/isPast/isFuture-style flag is recomputed.

**Represented:** Document title/content/contentState/color/icon/sortOrder/archive/trash/hidden values; contentData input maps to contentState. projectId/initiativeId/teamId/lastAppliedTemplateId and creator/updater/subscriber roles remain distinct. resourceFolderId is a stored opaque string; documentContentId is unjoined storage. DocumentContent has its own ID/content/state and independent context FKs; do not collapse it using uselist=False.

**Represented:** Initiative name/description/content/color/icon/status/targetDate/targetDateResolution/order/reminder frequency values and owner/creator/organization. InitiativeRelation has initiativeId/relatedInitiativeId/sortOrder; InitiativeToProject has initiativeId/projectId/sortOrder and independent identity. **Not consolidated:** the initiative_project pair table is not synchronized by these identified-link writers. Archive/delete/restore are behavior; update objects have only their actually stored fields.

**Represented:** Project name/description/content/color/icon/priority/order/date/state/health/reminder/progress values; leadId/statusId/template/convertedFromIssueId plus memberIds/teamIds/labelIds select existing roles/associations. Milestone name/description/descriptionData/targetDate/sortOrder and projectId stay on ProjectMilestone. Move returns previousIssueTeamIds/previousProjectTeamIds as transient prior membership information, not new persistent attributes. ProjectRelation project/relatedProject and optional milestone anchors plus anchorType/relatedAnchorType/type remain named roles and classifications. ProjectStatus/ProjectLabel are separate classifications, not scalar synonyms.

**Represented:** User profile/status/role/suspension flags and organization; UserFlag.flag/value/lastSyncId plus user identity; folded UserSettings values preserve settings-row id/presence. settings/input, notificationCategoryPreferences/notificationChannelPreferences/notificationDeliveryPreferences, subscriptions/unsubscribedFrom/feedSummarySchedule/usageWarningHistory are structured owner values. category/channel/subscribe indexes nested preference maps. flag operations incr/decr/clear/lock alter the existing value (lock uses 999999). Discord code/redirectUri and external service disconnection are behavior; synthetic discordUserId is not evidence of a real authorization flow.

**Represented:** Team naming/key/timezone/color/icon/order/privacy/estimate/cycle/SLA/triage/inheritance/configuration values at their stored names; role IDs keep distinct WorkflowState/Template/Cycle/parent/organization links. autoCloseStateId is interpreted by validation despite lacking an FK. TeamMembership id/teamId/userId/owner/sortOrder and archive/dates remain an identified relation object. **Derived:** Team.members and User.teams join memberships; no duplicate graph edge. copySettingsFromTeamId copies values, not a persistent new role. mapping and cycleEnabledStartDate are not implemented; teamKeyDelete is a no-op, not a managed TeamKey deletion.

**Represented:** Organization name/urlKey/logoUrl, configuration/policy/usage/trial/deletion values. Invite email/role/external/metadata_ and inviter/invitee/organization/teams map to the existing entity and pair table. Domain id/name/verification/claim/authentication configuration and creator remain on OrganizationDomain; no missing organization FK is invented. **Deferred:** verificationCode/deletionCode/auth credentials and trial/action inputs. Public advertised enforcement or external identity-provider behavior is not inferred from stored flags.

**Represented:** Notification readAt/snoozedUntilAt/unsnoozedAt/archive plus actor/externalActor/recipient and stored issue/project/initiative/update pointers. Bulk input IDs constrain those existing fields; oauthClientApprovalId is an opaque value, not a new local OAuth entity. **Qualified:** related target FKs are not exposed as fields of Notification’s SDL type; a mutation/filter can refer to them without direct readable links.

api_groups.mapping: **Represented:** IssueImport service/status/progress/mapping/metadata/csvFileUrl and creator/organization. External team/project/repo identifiers, teamName, includeClosedIssues, instantProcess and source organization are job metadata/configuration. **Deferred:** service tokens/credentials and process controls. No actual external issue population or source-system ER entities are established by these handlers.

api_groups.source: [api/resolvers.py](../../../backend/src/services/linear/api/resolvers.py) — `resolve_searchIssues; resolve_searchProjects; resolve_searchDocuments; resolve_attachmentSources; resolve_projectStatusProjectCount; filter helpers`
api_groups.mapping: **Derived:** search/filtered lists, attachment source summaries and project-status counts use existing fields/relations; count/archivedTeamCount/privateCount are query results. term/query/name/URL/Figma key/VCS branch filter existing records, not new entities. searchProjects exposes loaded scalar dictionaries plus metadata={} and ignores teamId/includeComments; searchIssues/searchDocuments have different predicates. **Deferred:** comparator vocabulary, and/or, some/every/none, ordering/pagination and snippet controls. An implemented filter is not automatically an exact read witness for every hidden relation.

**Represented:** only actually stored identity/roles on minimal entities. **Omitted from implemented inference:** missing emoji/user on Reaction, missing text/name on Template/update placeholders, missing history payload/timestamps. Issue.history references absent archivedAt/createdAt/updatedAt and returns an empty connection after exceptions; an empty result does not establish absence of stored history.

reverse_checks.check: Source inventory and schema class definitions, L-A1–L-A16. Review each minimal entity against its actual columns; retain all independently identified records and explicitly contract only nine pair tables plus the UserSettings fold.
